subject: fontfamily option for geom_text() and annotate()

messages.author: 1c5a2287e5dffb3e
messages.subject: fontfamily option for geom_text() and annotate()
parts:
I'm new to ggplot2 and am pleased with what I've been able to do
with it so far but ran into a problem with annotations.

It is possible to change the font family of text elements in legends
and axis titles with theme_text(), but from what I've seen it isn't
possible to do the same with plot annotations. Also, geom_text()
and annotate() have an argument to change font size but not
the family. In my particular case I need to set the family to a
utf-8 font for access to linguistic symbols.

Have I overlooked a way to set the font family on annotations?
If not, I'd like to suggest a fontfamily argument for geom_text()
and annotate() and/or themability for these elements in a future
version.

I've already accomplished what I need with grid.edit() but would
have been very happy not to dig so deep.

Best,

ronald

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: fontfamily option for geom_text() and annotate()
parts:
Hi Ronald,

Yes, this is a problematic omission and it's on my list of things to fix.

Hadley
